title: Latest Dev refuses to connect to DanaRSv3 with Wrong Password
body:
At around 10AM CET this morning, I installed the latest dev build (749bc49ad) on my Google Pixel4a with Android 11 and, as usual, the app tried to reconnect to my pump (a DanaRSv3).  However, it kept raising the Wrong Password alert.

I suspect that the changes in 341a53601 may be responsible but I'm a bit tied up so can't spend much time rebuilding multiple versions and trying each to confirm.  Certainly, there are specific changes to the PumpInterface and DanaRS drivers in this commit.  I've attached the relevant log files.  I tried a few times to exit from the app and restart (sometimes that clears an issue) and then tried actually restarting the phone (sometimes that also works) but neither changed the situation so I reverted to the previous working build I was using (32df0b949) and I'm now working again.  The pump reconnected after a few seconds.

Hopefully, the attached logs can help.


[AndroidAPS_LOG_1613552913198.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/5994561/AndroidAPS_LOG_1613552913198.log.zip)

comments.body: Looks like this has been fixed in one of the subsequent builds (531c74de6 looks like a good candidate).  I'm now running 2b3fcc60f and all worked fine on the reconnect after installation.
